title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Genesis 17: the covenant of circumcision, the new names Abraham and Sarah, and the promise of Isaac.

questions.text: How old was Abram when Yahweh appeared to him and said, "I am God Almighty"?
questions.explanation: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to him and said, "I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless."

questions.text: Complete God's command to Abram: "Walk before me and be..."
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to Abram, "I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless."

questions.text: Why was Abram's name changed to Abraham?
questions.explanation: God said his name would be Abraham, "for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations."

answers.text: He was made father of a multitude of nations
He had obeyed God's voice in all things
He would become a great and mighty king
He had built altars wherever he went

questions.text: What was to be the token of the covenant between God and Abraham?
questions.explanation: Every male was to be circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, and it would be a token of the covenant.

questions.text: At what age was a male to be circumcised?
questions.explanation: God said, "He who is eight days old will be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations."

questions.text: What new name did God give to Sarai?
questions.explanation: God said, "You shall not call her name Sarai, but her name will be Sarah."

questions.text: What did Abraham do when God said Sarah would give him a son?
questions.explanation: Abraham fell on his face and laughed, and said in his heart, "Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old?"

answers.text: He bowed down and wept for joy
He rose and built an altar
He ran into the tent to tell Sarah
He fell on his face and laughed

questions.text: What name did God say Sarah's son should be given?
questions.explanation: God said, "Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac."

questions.text: Ishmael would become the father of how many princes?
questions.explanation: God said of Ishmael, "He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation."

questions.text: How old was Ishmael when he was circumcised?
questions.explanation: Ishmael, Abraham's son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.
